name: What is the process for cleaning a main sewer line?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for cleaning a main sewer line?

acceptedAnswer.text: Main sewer line cleaning typically involves using specialized equipment to remove blockages and buildup. The process usually begins with an inspection using a sewer camera to identify the exact nature and location of the problem. Once identified, we use hydro-jetting, which employs high-pressure water to clear roots, grease, and debris, or a drain snake for smaller clogs. The choice of method depends on the blockage type and pipe condition. After clearing, a follow-up camera inspection ensures the line is thoroughly cleaned and free of obstructions. We ensure minimal disruption to your property during the service.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial camera inspection to locate the blockage, followed by hydro-jetting or snaking to clear it, and a final camera inspection to confirm the line is clean.
